tools.name: edinet_financials_usgaap
tools.description: Search official EDINET statutory balance sheet, income statement, and executive compensation for Japanese listed companies, strictly mapped to US GAAP / IFRS. Covers 5-year XBRL financials with J-GAAP / US GAAP / IFRS accounting concept mapping (e.g. 経常利益 vs Operating Income vs Ordinary Income).

company_name.description: Company name in Japanese (e.g. トヨタ自動車) or English (e.g. Toyota Motor), or 13-digit NTA corporate number, or 4-digit securities code.

metric.description: Financial metric to retrieve, e.g. revenue, operating_income, net_income, total_assets, equity, executive_compensation. Accepts English GAAP terms or Japanese accounting terms.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year (e.g. 2023). Omit to retrieve the latest available year.

tools.name: japan_corporate_registry
tools.description: Query official 13-digit National Tax Agency (NTA) corporate identity, registered headquarters address, legal status, and METI gBizINFO certifications, subsidies, and commendations for any Japanese company.

company_name.description: Company name in Japanese or English, or 13-digit NTA corporate number.

info_type.description: Type of registry information: identity, address, certifications, subsidies, commendations. Omit to retrieve all available information.

tools.name: japan_company_search
tools.description: Unified keyword, fuzzy, and semantic search across Japanese corporate registries and listed company filings. Supports search by company name (Japanese or English), securities code, corporate number, or any free-text query.

query.description: Search query: company name, securities code, 13-digit corporate number, or free-text (e.g. '東京 半導体メーカー', 'semiconductor Tokyo').

method.description: Retrieval method. auto (default): system chooses best method. bm25: exact keyword. trigram: fuzzy / identifier matching. vector: semantic. hybrid: RRF fusion of bm25+vector.

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 20).
